title_as_printed: Results of solution measurements with O2 at 298.15 K using the batch method: p is the pressure in the calorimeter system; c is the calibration constant; the electrical energy input was 0.2 J. I is the integrated calorimetric curve from the solution experiment. The uncertainty is given as 2 sigma(<x>)
pressure_note: pressure in the calorimeter system (printed once per group of runs from one syringe charge); not stated whether it includes water vapour

value.what: enthalpy of solution of O2 in water; printed value is the NEGATIVE of DeltaH (i.e. -DeltaH), so value = printed x -1

extra_unmapped: 10^4 c/(J V^-1 s^-1) calibration constant (printed between rows, attached here to the row above it)
conversion_needs: p is printed only on the first row of each group of runs from one syringe charge: fill down within group (rows 0-1 -> 99.11, 2-4 -> 99.04, 5-8 -> 98.23, 9-12 -> 102.36, 13-16 -> 102.70)
notes: Calibration constants sit vertically between data rows in the print; they are placed here on the row printed just above them and their association with individual runs is not exact. The row with p blank belongs to the same group. Mean row: 12.056 +- 0.019 kJ/mol (2 sigma of the mean); authors' final value with systematic errors included is -(12.06 +- 0.04) kJ/mol, text only.
